title: Call Radiant
answer: Call Radiant is a artifact field action with support intent. Aspects: CREATION, LIGHT. Baseline potency 21, range 12.000, duration 200, energy 40, cooldown 800, residue 100, priority 22, and 2 generic presentation beats. Its standard signature uses the light motif, artifact_light sound, and colours #FFF2B0 / #FF9D42.
